newsitem.title: JAPAN: JGBs buoyed by speculation about weak tankan.
newsitem.headline: JGBs buoyed by speculation about weak tankan.

text.p: The JGBs were buoyed on Tuesday by speculation that the Bank of Japan (BOJ)'s tankan quarterly corporate sentiment survey may show weak results, traders said.
Key September JGB was at 124.21 at 0145 GMT, up from Monday's 123.91.
There was widespread talk in the market that a senior BOJ official suggested in a closed meeting with some Japanese bank managers on Monday that the tankan result would be weak.
The JGBs were also bought on talk that a major U.S. brokerage firm which had given a relatively optimistic forecast for the tankan was revising it down, traders said.
